details:
Mars Micro Rover & Terrain Explorer is an advanced web-based control and telemetry dashboard designed to support and enhance Martian surface exploration.

​What it does & How it works: The system features a live navigation camera feed (Navcam) with automated obstacle and hazard detection (bounding boxes), an interactive Martian topographical map that dynamically tracks rover movements across multi-layered NASA data (elevation, minerals, radiation, and hazards), and a real-time environmental telemetry bar (temperature, radiation, and slope).

​Benefits & Intended Impact: It significantly enhances navigation safety and mission efficiency on Mars by minimizing collision risks, visualizing environmental hazards instantly, and providing reliable support for operators and automated rovers navigating rough extraterrestrial terrains.

​Tools & Technologies: Built from scratch using HTML5, CSS3, and native JavaScript for a responsive and lightweight user interface, integrating a custom local Navcam video simulation and CSS-based grid rendering.

​Creativity & Design Factors: Our project is creative because it bridges complex raw planetary datasets with an intuitive, interactive web-based mission control experience. The team carefully considered user experience, real-time telemetry responsiveness, navigation safety, and lightweight browser compatibility to ensure seamless performance.
